steps.text: jei-pinyin-search: open the inventory so JEI's ingredient overlay is up (the harness's throwaway level is creative, so the inventory bind opens the creative inventory)

jei-pinyin-search: focus JEI's search bar with a mouse click. JEI's field is not a widget of the open screen (measured 2026-10-16: the live widget tree of CreativeModeInventoryScreen carries the screen's own widgets and no JEI field - JEI's GuiTextFieldFilter is a private field of its overlay, never added to the screen), so a click dispatched at the screen does not reach it; click_mouse presses and releases through the client's own mouse handler, the body a real pointer goes through. 1181,704 is the bar's centre, read off this row's own capture (runs/mv-1.18.2-fabric-20261016-121122, screenshots/jei-pinyin-search/16_error.png): the pinned GUI space is 1280x720 at GUI scale 2, so a 2560x1440 framebuffer pixel is GUI(pixel/2) - a measured value, re-measure it if JEI's layout changes
jei-pinyin-search: type the pinyin of 石头 (shi tou) one character at a time
